citations.at: treaty with the Creek Nation, 10 July 1861: signatures p. 301 (Moty Kinniard, Principal Chief; Icho Hacho, Principal Chief Upper Creeks); the General Council's ratification of 20 July, p. 302 ("Motey Kinnaird, Principal Chief, Icho Hacho, First Chief of the Upper Creeks"); Opothleyahola appears nowhere among the signers, pp. 301 to 303

pp. 289-290, preamble and Article IV; the treaty names the act of 21 May as its prior public condition. [I] keep the existing State flag and dated lower bound; no presidential choice or troop-withdrawal route. This unsigned replacement awaits gate review.
